O.outcome_detail: responsible interpretation of institutional analytics visualizations

cells.quote: Findings indicated that combining a structured framework with AI-based guidance can enhance context-aware, responsible interpretation of institutional data.
cells.note: The study used a qualitative think-aloud design with each participant first interpreting a visualization without the chatbot and then with F ACTRIA-aware chatbot guidance; no numerical effect size was reported.

D.treatment: T-NOTECHS assessed in the van Maarseveen study
D.comparison: T-NOTECHS assessed in the Steinemann study

cells.quote: The T-NOTECHS papers which used ICC were Steinemann et al [23] who had an ICC score of 0.48 for real-life resuscitations and van Maarseveen [20] et al. had an ICC of 0.94 (0.87–0.98). Steinemann et al [23] report poor reliability and van Maarseveen et al [20] report excellent reliability.
cells.note: This is a cross-study comparison of reported inter-rater reliability estimates, not a direct randomized comparison; the studies differed in context and reviewer characteristics.

cells.quote: Association between T-NOTECHS scores and ROSC did not reach statistical significance.
cells.note: Observational study of 61 emergency department thoracotomy resuscitations conducted over 24 months; no explicit comparison threshold was stated.

D.treatment: high assessment and decision-making T-NOTECHS scores
D.comparison: lower assessment and decision-making T-NOTECHS scores

cells.quote: Assessment and decision-making high scores were 5.3x more likely to lead to ROSC
cells.note: The study text reports the magnitude but does not state statistical significance or provide an interval.
